name: Toujou Lena
source:
Because she's aiming to be a novelist, she writes novels in her spare time. She likes to read books and reads so much she needs glasses. As for the ribbon on her head, it was her father's first present to her, and even when it broke she bought a similar one and wears it daily.

Her father is a novelist. Serious, tough, and stubborn. Her mother was German and died while giving birth to Lena in Japan. After school, she spends most of the time in the library (or a used book store, when she's not on duty). She is also good at repairing books.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
